title: Republican Groups Rush to Paxton’s Aid in Texas After Staying on Sidelines
summary: An organization allied with Senate G.O.P. leaders has booked more than $51 million in ads. Now, Ken Paxton has a financial edge after months of being outspent by his Democratic rival.
